fato_historico: 1977: South African anti-apartheid activist Steve Biko dies in police custody.
energia_do_dia: Today, the cosmos invites you to reflect on the power of unwavering principles and the quiet strength of the human spirit. Much like a seed that defies the soil to seek the light, you may find that your persistence leads to unexpected growth. It is a good time to honor your integrity and stand firm in your authentic truth.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the courage to remain steadfast in your deepest convictions.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the wisdom of experience.
conselho: Consider how your dedication can plant seeds of positive change for your future.
